ITEM 1 | Flatbread wedge, golden tan with dark brown charred spots and blisters, folded triangular shape with a torn edge, slightly soft, upper right of plate, about 9 cm long by 5 cm wide, roughly 0.8 cm thick | 60
ITEM 2 | Corn rounds, bright yellow kernels with pale cream centers, cut crosswise into four thick discs about 4 to 5 cm across and 2.5 cm tall, moist and firm, lying along the right edge of plate | 260
ITEM 3 | Creamy baked mixture with pale off-white to beige color, lightly browned spots, soft and clumpy texture with some sheen, covering the lower left-center of plate about 9 cm by 7 cm, about 2 cm tall, with dark green leafy pieces tucked under and through it | 150
ITEM 4 | Dark green wilted leafy greens, glossy and limp, some strands and stems visible, partly under the creamy mixture at lower left, about 5 cm by 2 cm | 25
ITEM 5 | Scattered crumbly tan granular pieces, small and irregular, light brown with darker specks, a few small clusters near the center-left of plate, about 4 cm across, low height | 15
